newsitem.title: SPAIN: INSTANT VIEW - Spanish Aug consumer prices flat.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Spanish Aug consumer prices flat.

text.p: Following are analysts' comments on Spanish August consumer prices which rose 0.3 percent month-on-month for a 3.7 percent annual rate.
The data are milder than the 0.5 percent and 3.9 percent analysts had on average forecast.
MARISOL FRANCISCO, analyst at AFI
"In principle the number seems favourable, because after the tax rise at the end of June one could have expected an additional rise of two-tenths of a percentage point"
"The number shows that inflation continues to improve"
"The number allows the Bank of Spain to lower rates when it feels this would be opportune, although one still needs to wait and see what will happen with the budget."
CARMEN HERNANSANZ, ECONOMIST AT MERRILL LYNCH
"This is a good number, better than forecast. A positive surprise."
"Without the tax rise, CPI would have gone up 0.2 percent."
"It is a good argument for the Bank of Spain to cut interest rates although that will depend on the budget."
"Inflation will continue to decline in what is left of the year."
ISABEL LASHERAS, ECONOMIST AT SOCIETE GENERALE
"The number is very good and the truth is it has surprised us."
"It seems that fresh foods went down, which is good news.
"The number is even more positive because August is a tourist month and tends toward an inflation rise"
"The rise in tobacco and alcohol prices hasn't had much impact"
"The Bank of Spain is more focused on the budget. Now there are pressuring the governmenment to prepare an authentically restrictive budget."
GREGORIO GOMEZ, ECONOMIST
"The CPI has come in at the lower end of expectations and falls in with the positive performance we've seen all year."
"From now on the danger might be from the rise in oil prices."
"I don't think this will be a key figure for the Bank of Spain. The bank is more worried about the budget, and that will be the subject that pushes them to move on rates"
